maria-cs: Quick Day0 check for Skylark private/VPC onboarding. Top items: TGW routes, NAT egress, KMS cross-account, CloudTrail -> S3 delivery. Any red flags?

raj-infra: Added route 10.90.3.0/24 -> tgw-9; propagation now "available". Ran curl to collector 34.122.11.99:443  TCP ok but 403 from collector (needs whitelist).
ops-bot: cloudtrail_event: "skylark-org-trail" created at 2026-06-08T09:12Z

maria-cs: Risk: if KMS approval delayed past Friday, mark renewal risk. leo, please add to tracker and note mitigation (temporary ingest key we manage).
leo-se: Added risk "KMS approval pending" w/ mitigation and owner.
raj-infra: CloudTrail PutObject initially 403 due to bucket policy Deny; added explicit allow for cloudtrail.amazonaws.com and re-delivered successfully.
maria-cs: Actions: raj - confirm collector after whitelist; hana - paste KMS snippet into runbook and DM PM; leo - track risk and schedule follow-up Thu 10:00 UTC. Thanks! :thumbsup:
